title: Orbital Command Demo Launch - 3d Spaceship based rts/rpg hybrid.
author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
selftext:
I am very excited to be launching the demo for Orbital Command on Friday 25th.

https://youtu.be/xYFyljcesyk?si=u\_2vQTvIJnkaDp-2

Launch announcement:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/5112040/view/713413492630094912?l=english

Steam Store Page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112040/Enarian\_Orbital\_Command/

Please check it out and a Wishlist would be much appriciated.

The game is a combination of Vibe Coding in Cursor and human built resources, all the ship models and stations were built by a person. Largely because I couldnt get mesh models from the likes of Meshy and Tripio that didnt melt into a mess as soon as you added textures.

That said the models were well worth the money as I think they are excellent.

I hope you will check out the demo when it launches on Friday.
